units.prompt:
Vertical 9:16; three-quarter key + fill (standard set-up), soft light (almost no lit / shadow edge), neutral (about 5000K), background clearly blurred (shallow depth of field / portrait mode). Hard cuts between shots.
Shot 1 (0.0–1.9s): Close-up, hands lift a grey padded halo ring out of a green box in front of a seated yellow Labrador, then clip the black harness on
Shot 2 (1.9–2.7s): Close-up, hands lift a grey padded halo ring out of a green box in front of a seated yellow Labrador, then clip the black harness on
Shot 3 (2.7–5.8s): Medium shot, a senior yellow Labrador wearing a grey halo harness walks past a sofa, the ring bumps the sofa before his nose; then the dog walks along a white garden fence

review_story.summary: Blind-dog halo: owner tries a cardboard ring on an old Labrador (the idea) vs unboxing the padded halo and strapping it on, then the dog walks around furniture and the garden.
review_story.hook: 'The idea 🤢' + a cardboard-and-tape ring held around a sad-looking senior Lab's head.
highlights: 0–4s: the DIY fail is funny and sad at once; dog's face is the second character
4–8s: 'Vs...' unbox from a green box, hold the real halo up, buckle the harness, 3 shots
8–14s: 'The result 😍❤️' dog walking, the ring touches the sofa before his face, then in the garden
No on-screen CTA; 'Comment BLIND' in caption
